text_block_list.text:
The cops and robbers tournament,
suspended due
to Твин Турбо's chaotic
charge, resumes on
another day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Another close contest between the two
teams
unfolds beneath a clear blue sky!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Hehe, I got away again!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Psh! This is sooo easy! They're never gonna catch me before the time runs out!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Awww, whaaat?! But I've still got gas in
the tank!
I'm gonna win without even
breaking a swe—
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Run, Turbo! Run! The cops—they're...
text_block_list.name: Robber Team Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Huh? Whoa! They're behind me!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Now, everyone. Surround them!
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
There won't be time for further
attempts, but if
we can capture the last
two people now, victory
will be ours!
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: Okayyy! Let's go!
text_block_list.name: Cop Team Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho-ho! They're coming from in
front too!
Nice! Now I'm getting fired up!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, my little minion! You've gotta
get away
too!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Ack! Owie!
text_block_list.name: Robber Team Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Miniooooon! Are you okay?!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
S-stay away! Leave me behind and run,
Turbo!
You've gotta win!
text_block_list.name: Robber Team Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
...Okay! I'll get away and I'll win! For
you!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: This is a straight path hemmed in by trees and a pond. There is no escape route... You will be caught!
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
No! I've gotta get away for all the other
robbers'
sakes!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
TURBO BOOOOOST! I'm crankin' up the

backburners!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
She torched everyone chasing her with
her red
hot dash! That's Твин Турбо for
you!
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper

text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... I-I've still... got gas left... in the tank...
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
It appears she's expended all her
energy. Now's
our chance!
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: Noooo! I won't let you get me!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
choice_data_list: Go full throttle on that Turbo engine!

text_block_list.text: Urgh! More! FULL TURBO BOOOOOST!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Ahhhhh! GOOOOO! Get away from
them, Twin
Turbo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: You will not... escape! HAAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus! You can catch her! Go, go,
gooo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: You can do it, Turbo!
text_block_list.name: Robber Team Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
The tournament comes to an end amidst
the
sounds of thunderous footsteps and
cheers from
the crowd...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And the side that scrapes through to
victory is...
the robbers!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! What'd I tell ya? We won! Bet
you're real
glad you were a robber!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
choice_data_list: I was just keeping an eye on things!

text_block_list.text:
I keep tellin' ya not to sweat the small
stuff! Your
strategy was a huge success!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah! I can't believe this! I got
caught! Ikuno
caught meee!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
No. You did not fall victim to me, but to
the
combined efforts of the whole cop
team.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! You're so cool, Ikuno!
text_block_list.name: Cop Team

text_block_list.text:
That was still an amazing run, though!
Great job,
Твин Турбо!
text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll get away next time!

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff, huff, huff, huff, huff!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
choice_data_list: Y-you don't have to breathe so fast!

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter... As long as I run... as
fast... as I
can... till... the... end...
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: ...Got you!
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: I won't give up! I WON'T! YAAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Tweeeet!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The whistle signals the end of the game.
And the
winner of the final one-on-one
bout iiis...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: AWW YEEEAH! I... won! I got... away!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Didja see me? I'm so strong!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
So close, and yet victory eluded us... It
pains me
to admit this, but you did well.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to race again whenever you
are! I'm
lookin' forward to it!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Твин Турбо beams with pride after using
her
signature turbo boost to seize
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The crowd showers the two racers with
applause
as they praise each other's
performance in the
close contest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Argh! Yes! Next time, I'll definitely escape!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
